subject: math
question: 计算 $\lim_{x\to 0}\left(\frac{\ln(1 + \mathrm{e}^{\frac{2}{x}})}{\ln(1 + \mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x}})} -2[x]\right),[x]$ 表示不超过 $x$ 的最大整数.
answer: 所求极限为 $2$（$x\to0^+$ 与 $x\to0^-$ 均为 2）

steps.text: 分析 [x] 是分段函数，x=0 是分段点，需计算左、右极限.

\begin{array}{r l} & {\underset {x \to 0 ^ {-}} {\lim} \left(\frac {\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {2}{x}})}{\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {1}{x}})} - 2 [ x ]\right) = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {-}} {\lim} \left(\frac {\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {2}{x}})}{\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {1}{x}})} + 2\right) = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {-}} {\lim} \frac {e ^ {\frac {2}{x}}}{e ^ {\frac {1}{x}}} + 2 = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {-}} {\lim} e ^ {\frac {1}{x}} + 2 = 2;} \\ & {\underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \left(\frac {\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {2}{x}})}{\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {1}{x}})} - 2 [ x ]\right) = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \left(\frac {\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {2}{x}})}{\ln (1 + e ^ {\frac {1}{x}})} + 0\right) = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {\ln \left[ e ^ {\frac {2}{x}} (e ^ {- \frac {2}{x}} + 1) \right]}{\ln \left[ e ^ {\frac {1}{x}} (e ^ {- \frac {1}{x}} + 1) \right]}} \\ & {\qquad = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {\frac {2}{x} + \ln (1 + e ^ {- \frac {2}{x}})}{\frac {1}{x} + \ln (1 + e ^ {- \frac {1}{x}})} = \underset {x \to 0 ^ {+}} {\lim} \frac {2 + x \ln (1 + e ^ {- \frac {2}{x}})}{1 + x \ln (1 + e ^ {- \frac {1}{x}})} = 2.} \end{array}

solution.final_answer: 所求极限为 $2$（$x\to0^+$ 与 $x\to0^-$ 均为 2）
